confirmed_findings.title: Queued preference pause, import and Undo could commit after dismissal and reopen a stale panel
confirmed_findings.reproduction: Actual production preference panel and actual learning store with a queued native-lock model. Start pause/import-confirm/Undo-confirm, close or replace the originating modal before its lock callback enters, release the lock. All six cases still mutated saved data and reopened Outfit preferences over the current UI.

baseline.note: Three uninterrupted actions passed; six cancelled actions failed.

confirmed_findings.fix: saveForPanel captures each action modal token, refuses the mutation inside exclusive when inactive, only calls onChanged for a real save, and only reopens review when the originating modal remains current.

independent_verification.scope: All six close/replace cancellations preserve the complete durable state and current panel; all three uninterrupted actions still succeed exactly once.

other_review_results: Photo picker selects the approved reconstructed non-suit no-tie detail only under an exact blazer or shirt-only anchor. Suit and unanchored paths retain the original suit detail. DS026 contextual difference is intentional and preserved.

The thumbnail descriptor is still checked for the current approved input hash, exact garment identity, constrained source key/type, SHA-256 filename and repository-relative image path. No URL or source-pixel substitution was introduced.
The shirt label helper replaces only the exact old source-repaired collar/body pilot placeholder with its existing pinned description. Original manifest/history/provenance values remain unchanged.
Rejection manager normalizes a separate selection/occasion display copy. Source event bytes and notes remain intact, saved alias labels remain visible, and Undo uses the original event ID.
Queued vote rechecks the captured comparison context and feedback token after lock acquisition. Comparison preflight and delayed file read respect modal replacement and the most recent file choice.

A potential stale-error concern was checked against the actual central button wrapper: it already suppresses errors when the action modal token changed, so no redundant catch or further code change is required.

limitations: The nine-case queue harness uses a controlled lock queue and DOM surface, with actual preference UI/store functions. Browser focus, native lock availability and two-tab browser scheduling remain root-owned verification.
Existing UI suite includes 1024 combinations of reason checkboxes within one test; this is not reported as 1024 distinct tests.
No additional asset visual/pixel-equality claim is made by this storage/UI cross-review. Root owns the source atlases, full photo matrix and frozen-asset integrity checks.
Only the stated source paths and boundaries were independently reviewed; full central application routing/rule review is handled by the other owners.
